title: Benefit Payments While Claimant Identity Verification Is Pending
content:
While a Claimant Identity Verification case is pending, benefit payments on the linked claim are held with the hold reason identity verification, and the claimant must keep certifying each week.

## What happens to payments

- **While the case is pending.** Payments on the linked claim are held for identity verification. The claimant must keep certifying each week.
- **When the case is verified.** The identity hold on the linked claim is released, and every week certified while the case was pending is paid if it is otherwise payable.
- **Weeks not certified.** A week that was not certified while the case was pending is not paid on verification and can be paid only through a late certification with good cause.
- **When the case expires.** The hold remains, and no week is paid unless the case is reopened and verified.

## Outcome table

| Case outcome | Identity hold on the linked claim | Weeks certified while pending | Weeks not certified while pending |
|---|---|---|---|
| Verified | released | paid, if otherwise payable | not paid on verification; payable only through a late certification with good cause |
| Expired | remains | not paid unless the case is reopened and verified | not paid unless the case is reopened and verified |

## Example (hypothetical weeks)

A claimant's case is pending for four benefit weeks. The claimant certifies weeks 1, 2 and 4 and does not certify week 3. When the case is verified, the identity hold is released and weeks 1, 2 and 4 are paid if each is otherwise payable. Week 3 is not paid on verification; it can be paid only through a late certification with good cause.

Had the same case expired instead, the hold would remain and none of the four weeks would be paid unless the case were reopened and verified.
